import ast

import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path('/home/wlodzimierrr/bitcoin_swing')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from btc_predictor.research_backtest import input_census as ic, input_census_registry as reg, coverage as cov
from btc_predictor.risk import trailing

CASES = {
 'computed': 'def root(value):\n def local(item):\n  return item\n return local(value+2)\n',
 'escape': 'def root(value):\n def local(item):\n  return item\n return local\n',
 'decorator': 'import functools\ndef root(value):\n @functools.cache\n def local(item):\n  return item\n return local(1)\n',
 'rebinding': 'def root(value):\n def local(item):\n  return item\n local = value\n return local(1)\n',
 'nonbuiltin': 'def consumer(items,key):\n return sorted(items,key=key)\ndef root(value):\n return consumer(value,key=lambda item: item)\n',
 'nested_class': 'def root(value):\n class Local:\n  def method(self,item):\n   return item\n return Local().method(value)\n',
 'deep_escape': 'def root(value):\n def outer():\n  def inner(item):\n   return item\n  return inner\n return outer()\n',
}

def load(source,name):
    filename = str(ROOT/'btc_predictor'/('r2_review_memory_'+name+'.py'))
    module_name = 'btc_predictor.r2_review_memory_'+name
    mod = types.ModuleType(module_name)
    mod.__file__ = filename
    linecache.cache[filename] = (len(source),None,source.splitlines(True),filename)
    sys.modules[module_name] = mod
    exec(compile(source,filename,'exec'),mod.__dict__)
    return mod

for name,source in CASES.items():
    module = load(source,name)
    root = ic.DecisionPathRoot(module.__name__,'root',ic.AREA_LIFECYCLE,'Independent R2 mutation')
    c = ic.discover_decision_path((root,))
    externals = [r for r in c.nested.values() if r.classification == ic.NESTED_EXTERNAL]
    assert externals, name
    if name in ('nested_class','deep_escape'):
        assert any(r.qualname.endswith('Local.method' if name=='nested_class' else 'outer.<locals>.inner') for r in externals)
    # The hypothetical pinned callable/basis must still require classifications
    # for external parameters. No real registry is changed or regenerated.
    with patch.object(cov,'INPUT_TYPE_FIELD_CLASSIFICATIONS',{}), \
         patch.object(cov,'ROOT_PARAMETER_CLASSIFICATIONS',{root.path:{'value':cov._config('synthetic')}}), \
         patch.object(reg,'DISCOVERED_TYPES',{}), \
         patch.object(reg,'DISCOVERED_CALLABLES',{p:r.parameter_names for p,r in c.callables.items() if p!=root.path}), \
         patch.object(reg,'DISCOVERED_NESTED_CALLABLES',{p:(r.classification,r.basis) for p,r in c.nested.items()}), \
         patch.object(cov,'EXTERNAL_NESTED_PARAMETER_CLASSIFICATIONS',{}):
        try:
            cov.enumerate_input_surface(c)
        except cov.InputSurfaceError as error:
            assert error.code == 'UNCLASSIFIED_PARAMETER', (name,error.code)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(name+' accepted missing external classification')
    print('A2',name,'PASS:',[(r.qualname,r.basis) for r in externals])

before = ic.discover_decision_path()
filename = inspect.getfile(trailing)
tree = ast.parse(Path(filename).read_text())
owner = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='calculate_trailing_stop')
helper = next(n for n in owner.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='held')
helper.args.kwonlyargs.append(ast.arg(arg='independent_new_input'))
helper.args.kw_defaults.append(ast.Constant(True))
result = next(n for n in ast.walk(helper) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='_result')
kw = next(k for k in result.keywords if k.arg=='complete')
kw.value = ast.IfExp(ast.Name('independent_new_input',ast.Load()),kw.value,ast.Constant(False))
ast.fix_missing_locations(tree)
ns = dict(trailing.__dict__)
exec(compile(tree,filename,'exec'),ns)
original_code = trailing.calculate_trailing_stop.__code__
trailing.calculate_trailing_stop.__code__ = ns['calculate_trailing_stop'].__code__
try:
    current = ic.discover_decision_path()
    result,trace = ic.trace_owner_calls(lambda:trailing.calculate_trailing_stop(direction='long',previous_stop=90,structure_price=None,buffer=None))
    path = 'btc_predictor.risk.trailing.calculate_trailing_stop.<locals>.held'
    assert path in trace.functions
    assert any('independent_new_input' in e for e in ic.uncovered_traced(before,trace)['functions'])
    assert not any(ic.uncovered_traced(current,trace).values())
    try:
        cov.enumerate_input_surface(current)
    except cov.InputSurfaceError as error:
        assert error.code == 'UNCLASSIFIED_PARAMETER' and 'independent_new_input' in str(error)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('held input accepted')
finally:
    trailing.calculate_trailing_stop.__code__ = original_code
print('A4 independent whole-module held mutation PASS; executed, traced, refused')

module = load('def hidden(item):\n return item+1\ndef root(callback):\n def allowed(item):\n  return callback(item)\n return allowed(1)\n','allowed_callee')

_,trace = ic.trace_owner_calls(lambda:module.root(module.hidden))
missing = ic.uncovered_traced(c,trace)['functions']
assert any(module.__name__+'.hidden' in e for e in missing)

assert any(allowed.path in e for e in ic.uncovered_traced(without,trace)['functions'])
